questions.stem: What is the electronic configuration of calcium (atomic number 20)?
questions.explanation: Calcium has 20 electrons, filling shells as follows: 1st shell = 2, 2nd shell = 8, 3rd shell = 8, 4th shell = 2. This gives the configuration 2,8,8,2. Having 2 outer electrons places it in Group 2, and 4 shells places it in Period 4.
